summary: A Yes vote renews the district's expiring parcel tax and sets it at $144 per parcel per year for 9 years, raising about $3 million annually for teacher retention and class-size reduction.

schools.text: A Yes vote would direct the parcel-tax revenue to class-size reduction, teacher retention, counseling, tutoring and other programs in Dublin Unified schools.
schools.quote: The money raised would be spent on maintaining small class sizes, attracting and retaining teachers and on student counseling, tutoring and other types of academic assistance programs.
